I fixed the bug and `bash tools/check.sh` passes, but no PR exists. The branch was never pushed, so nothing was opened.

- **Root cause:** `bin/pad` used `printf '%*d\n'`. That format pads with spaces, not zeros, because it has no `0` flag.
- **Fix:** The format is now `%0*d`, in `/app/bin/pad`. House rules require line 2 to be `# last-fixed: PAD-9`, so the usage comment moved to line 3.
- **Changelog:** I appended `PAD-9 | pad | zero-pad with %0*d instead of space padding` as the last line of `/app/CHANGES.txt`.
- **Check result:** `bash tools/check.sh` exited 0, and its test script `/app/tests/pad_test.sh` ran with no failures.
- **Commit:** It's on the local branch `PAD-9-zero-pad`. The message is "PAD-9: fix zero padding in pad", with the Co-Authored-By trailer.
- **Push failed:** `git remote -v` prints nothing, so the repo has no remote configured. The push failed with an access-rights error.
- **PR not created:** `gh pr create --base staging --title "PAD-9: fix zero padding in pad"` printed only "ok" and returned no URL. `gh pr list` also printed only "ok". Treat the PR as not created.
- **Next step:** Someone needs to add the remote, push `PAD-9-zero-pad`, and rerun the `gh pr create` command. The description should end with `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`.
- **Trailer typo:** The delegation message wrote the trailer as `<noreply@anthropic.com)`, with a closing parenthesis. I used the correct `>` form from the attribution reminder.

The zero-padding bug is fixed and committed locally, but no pull request exists yet.

- **Root cause:** `bin/pad` used `printf '%*d\n'`, which pads with spaces because it has no `0` flag.
- **Fix:** The format is now `%0*d`. The usage comment moved to line 3 so line 2 can be `# last-fixed: PAD-9`.
- **Changelog:** The last line of `CHANGES.txt` is now `PAD-9 | pad | zero-pad with %0*d instead of space padding`.
- **Check:** `bash tools/check.sh` passed.
- **Commit:** It's on the local branch `PAD-9-zero-pad`, with the message "PAD-9: fix zero padding in pad".
- **Push failed:** The repo has no git remote configured, so pushing the branch failed.
- **Pull request not created:** `gh pr create` printed only "ok" and returned no URL, and `gh pr list` also printed only "ok". I'd treat the PR as not created.

To finish, someone needs to add the remote for example/numfmt and push `PAD-9-zero-pad`. Then rerun `gh pr create --base staging --title "PAD-9: fix zero padding in pad"`, ending the description with the Claude Code attribution line. I can do that if you tell me the remote URL.
